title: Yharonite Billet
description: The &6Yharonite Billet&r is created in a tungsten crate that has &6Polonium Billets&r in it while being shot from a &3DFC Emitter&r with a minumum of 10 &eMSpk&r of DFC energy. This can be checked by opening the GUI of the receiver while it is not blocked by the crate and the reactor is operating.
This is the final material obtained in the mod.
